Author: Sadonia
Name: CraftBuddy
Punchline: Gets every material for a craft — retainers, mob drops, gathering, fishing, reduction, vendors — then crafts it with Artisan.
Description:
Pick a recipe or an item and how many. CraftBuddy works out everything it needs, sub-crafts included, and gets it: it takes what your retainers hold first, farms mob drops with vnavmesh and Wrath Combo, gathers and fishes through GatherBuddy Reborn (buying the right bait), uses aetherial reduction only when nothing else gives the material, and buys from vendors. Then it goes home and crafts with Artisan, and stores the leftovers with your retainers.

CraftBuddy used to be called DropBuddy; your settings carry over.

Requires: vnavmesh, Wrath Combo. Optional: Lifestream, GatherBuddy Reborn, Artisan, AutoHook, AutoRetainer, FateRunner.

Author: Sadonia
Name: FateRunner
Punchline: Automated FATE farming for Bicolor Gemstones or leveling.
Description: Finds FATEs, flies to them, level syncs, fights with Wrath Combo (BossMod AI optional), handles hand-in and escort FATEs, keeps your chocobo out, and hops zones. Requires vnavmesh and Wrath Combo.

Author: sad0nia.velvet
Name: MogFlix
Description: Polls your Plex Media Server and displays the currently playing movie or episode, with play state and progress, in your own nameplate and the server info bar. Sharing this with other players requires the separate Honorific plugin.
Punchline: Shows what you're watching on Plex, in-game.

Author: Sadonia
Name: Target Zoom
Punchline: Put the camera on anyone — right-click them and pick Zoom In.
Description:
Right-click any character in the world, on the party list or in chat and pick Zoom In. The camera swings around to face them and moves in close, and it stays on them as they move.

• Nearby list: everyone around you with job icons, distance and a name search. Double-click to zoom, right-click for options.
• Framing pad: drag to slide the view around them to set up the shot.
• Mirror: look at yourself from the front to check your glam or expression.
• Player Sync / Lightless: filter the list to synced people, with PS / LL badges.
• Hide UI while zoomed for clean screenshots.
• Top bar button to open it, showing who you're zoomed on.

When you stop, the camera returns behind you at your old zoom. It stops on its own if they leave, you zone, a cutscene starts or you enter combat — all adjustable in settings.
